headline: Expanse, Nevish Line Flare as Mercy Holds Hot
war_summary: Latest wires show fighting quickening across three central fronts after the midnight lull, with the Weathered Expanse reporting nine transfers in two hours, eleven in six and fifty-eight on the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance for five Warden, one Colonial and three ruined posts, day losses reaching 6,541 Colonial and 6,462 Warden and now accelerating. The Nevish Line likewise quickens to nine in two hours, nineteen in six and thirty-nine on the day about Mistle Shrine, Grief Mother and Princefal for six Colonial and two Warden posts, with 11,144 Colonial and 13,210 Warden losses accelerating. Linn Mercy holds hot at five in two hours and thirty-six on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for seven Colonial, two Warden and two ruined posts, all last heard at the hour. Mooring County and Stonecradle have gone quiet in two hours, last heard at 2243 about the Wind Hills for a full Warden dozen and at 2031 about World's End, while Marban Hollow remains silent since the prior day about Oster Wall and Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands bleed heavily with no transfers.
